# Support iVDrive

iVDrive is built and hosted independently so Škoda / VW Group drivers can use it without running servers. Sponsorships keep the domain, infrastructure and development sustainable.

**Product page:** [ivdrive.eu/sponsors](https://ivdrive.eu/sponsors/)

## Where support goes

- Domain (ivdrive.eu) and hosting for the public beta
- Backups, monitoring and security work
- Ongoing feature development and documentation

## How to support

- [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/m7xlab)
- [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/m7xlaboratory)
- [Buy Me a Coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/m7xlab)

Or use the **Sponsor** button on this repository.

## Other ways to help

- Tell other EV owners about iVDrive
- Contribute code or docs — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Report issues — [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/m7xlab/iVDrive/issues)

Thank you.
